title: What Really Matters When Kids Build Projects?

rows.text: Travel back two thousand years with today's food in a time-travel bag. What would feeding five thousand people cost?
rows.spoken_text: Travel back two thousand years with today's food in a time-travel bag. What would feeding five thousand people cost?

rows.text: Suppose the ingredients for a simple meal for everyone cost two or three thousand dollars. Many families could afford that today. Would feeding five thousand still count as a miracle?
rows.spoken_text: Suppose the ingredients for a simple meal for everyone cost two or three thousand dollars. Many families could afford that today. Would feeding five thousand still count as a miracle?

rows.text: As material life gets easier, what do kids need most?
rows.spoken_text: As material life gets easier, what do kids need most?

rows.text: For many Chinese American children around us, food, clothing, and basic living needs are met. Love, belonging, and recognition can matter more in their daily lives.
rows.spoken_text: For many Chinese American children around us, food, clothing, and basic living needs are met. Love, belonging, and recognition can matter more in their daily lives.

rows.text: Being included at school, getting likes on Instagram, or finding teammates in a game.
rows.spoken_text: Being included at school, getting likes on Instagram, or finding teammates in a game.

rows.text: Winning competitions, skiing well, playing tennis or cello, even finding rare game gear: each can answer the same question. Am I worth noticing?
rows.spoken_text: Winning competitions, skiing well, playing tennis or cello, even finding rare game gear: each can answer the same question. Am I worth noticing?

rows.text: Lucas Academy offers Chinese and English, art, and software projects we build together. Today, let's talk about software projects.

rows.text: Games, pictures, short videos: as much as you want. But what do they give our children?
rows.spoken_text: Games, pictures, short videos: as much as you want. But what do they give our children?

rows.text: Some content is like junk food: filling, but not nourishing. With media, as with food, more isn't always better.
rows.spoken_text: Some content is like junk food: filling, but not nourishing. With media, as with food, more isn't always better.

rows.text: AI makes polished work easier to produce. But how much of the child's own thinking is in it?
rows.spoken_text: AI makes polished work easier to produce. But how much of the child's own thinking is in it?

rows.text: We start with children's interests and build their work step by step. Through choices and revisions, children practice judgment, ownership, leadership, and teamwork.
